judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer never challenges the GZK cutoff direction claim or flags 'lower bound' as contradicting Greisen/Zatsepin-Kuzmin.
The review discusses the GZK cutoff conceptually but does not specifically flag the sentence claiming it is a lower bound, nor does it challenge Greisen/Zatsepin-Kuzmin as contradicting that claim.

The reviewer notes several grammatical errors in Section 1 and mentions the GZK cutoff conceptually, but does not flag the reversal of the GZK limit from an upper bound to a lower bound or the contradiction with the cited sources.
The reviewer does not flag the abstract's 10^19 eV threshold as inconsistent with the body's 10^20 eV anchor.

The reviewer mentions observed energies around 10^20 eV and trans-GZK thresholds, but does not identify an abstract-vs-body mismatch or specifically flag the abstract's 10^19 eV threshold as inconsistent.

The reviewer identifies the Amaterasu energy as 10^20 eV in their summary, demonstrating awareness of the correct scale, but they do not flag the 10^19 eV typo in the abstract as a discrepancy with the body.
No mention of the Dirac monopole charge formula g=2eα or any inconsistency between formula and stated value 3.3×10^-8 esu.
Although the reviewer critiques the monopole acceleration argument, they do not mention the Dirac monopole charge formula or any inconsistency between g=2eα and the stated numerical value.

The reviewer critiques the acceleration parameters and energy results in Section 2 but does not comment on the incorrect Dirac charge formula 'g = 2eα' or its inconsistency with the provided numerical value.
The reviewer mentions Figure 5 but only criticizes its caption; no flag of a Figure 4 vs Figure 5 cross-reference mismatch.
The reviewer refers to Figure 5 as central and comments on its caption, but does not explicitly identify that a sentence describing the ratio plot incorrectly points to Figure 4 instead of Figure 5.
The reviewer critiques the content of Figure 5 and the statistical analysis in Section 4 but fails to notice or report that the text incorrectly directs the reader to Figure 4 for the ratio plot.
